items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: Well, we had a band that I first started playing in. The manager was named Jake Johnson.

ctx.x: Can you remember what the music was like over there? Because we hear a lot of it about, we talk to everyone from New Orleans, but what kind of music was over in Morgan City? I've never heard much about it. Any bands over there?

Well, we had a band that I first started playing in. The manager was named Jake Johnson. At that time we were playing, but it wasn't a Dixieland music. We was playing swing music, but it wasn't Dixieland music.
What were you playing, Sammy? From sheet music? Or how were you playing?
